title: One fallback serves many words
hook: One fallback serves many words. Follow the computed steps.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Use trie failure links to continue multi-pattern matching after a transition misses.

misconception: Searching several patterns requires running an independent full search for each.
objective: Use trie failure links to continue multi-pattern matching after a transition misses.

claims.text: A failure link retains the longest suffix that is also a trie prefix. The trace falls back without rereading the whole text, then continues to a later pattern match.
